notes: Original default Fund prefab, not a money icon.
Mesh has ONE submesh and TWO renderer materials; extra PigShadow material re-renders the last submesh using its shadow shader. Do not apply the pig atlas as a second body pass.

Source root position/rotation are overridden by ChessboardManager.InitFund and RefreshFund: local position zero, rotation identity, original scale10 retained. Use runtimeMatrixInMainCityRoot or placement multiplied by runtimeTransform.
Placement is relative to MainCityRoot, not the scaled/rotated Chessboard subtree.
